'''Elba 0''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Elba 0 was assigned to [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], working alongside [[Blue 9]] and [[Winter Celchu|Targeter]]. They reported on increased [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] activity around [[Station 1B6/Green]].<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
